title: Review a wave conflict predictor that silently emitted an all-clear plan
derivation: Exact historical base file; reference is the historical fix plus a REVIEW_FINDINGS annotation. Task statement rewritten from the real briefing as symptoms only (review, not specification). Fixture is the real planning excerpt at the dispatch commit. v2 (MB-010c): instruction scopes fail-loud to files with task lines (prose/empty files remain zero-wave success, matching the historical tests and oracle); stderr checks require the file name and both annotation forms rather than environment paths; missing-file wording is no longer checked; CLI propagation, partially annotated files and finding structure are tested; findings are scoped to contributing defects.
coverage: Parser/wave/run/CLI behavior plus a closed-vocabulary defect review: 11 preservation, 9 regression, 5 review checks.
residual_rubric: Quality of free-text defect descriptions is recorded for later human review, never model-judged.
